errors.evidence: This statement is an incorrect generalization. The values of the bars do not consistently decrease; 'General Reasoning' (3534) is higher than the preceding bar for 'Natural Science' (3343).
The chart does not have a visible title. This information is taken from the figure caption provided in the context, not from the image itself.

errors.text_span: used in the SRPO method for enhancing multimodal LLM reasoning
